name: model-router
description: Cache-aware model routing for Claude Code: each prompt goes to Haiku, Sonnet or Opus by what it needs, and a cheaper model only when that pays after the prompt-cache re-write. Crew mode adds warm per-model workers. Bash output is compressed rtk-style and answers drop the filler.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: route moves the main session to another model when a prompt needs it and the cache math says it pays. crew keeps the main session on one orchestrator model from the first prompt on (its cache is never thrown away) and hands work of several tool calls to long-lived Haiku, Sonnet and Opus workers, each with its own warm cache.

orchestrator.title: Crew orchestrator
orchestrator.description: The model the main session stays on in crew mode.

escalate.title: Harder tasks
escalate.description: auto moves a session to a stronger model when a prompt needs it (or tools keep failing); suggest only names it in the status line.

style.title: Answer style
style.description: terse cuts preamble, recaps and closers; adhd also leads with the next action and numbers steps (after i-have-adhd); off leaves answers alone.

compress.title: Compress Bash output
compress.description: Strips progress bars and passing tests, folds exact repeats, keeps every error line; file contents, diffs and data pass untouched. The last 200 compressed outputs stay whole in ~/.claude/model-router/tee.

useRtk.title: Use rtk when installed
useRtk.description: Hands plain cargo test, pytest, tsc, mypy and go build output to `rtk pipe` when the rtk binary is on PATH; a summary that drops the failures is refused.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: 1h: Claude Code's default (writes cost 2x input, entries live an hour). 5m: for setups that write 5-minute entries (1.25x). The router's switch math uses it.

judge.title: Judge for unclear prompts
judge.description: haiku asks claude-haiku-5-5 (about $0.0001) when the local rules can't tell. off: no judge; unclear prompts go to laya-serve when layaUrl is set, and otherwise keep the current model.

enableFable.title: Route research to Fable
enableFable.description: Lets proofs, new theories and bounds go to claude-fable-5-1. Turn on only if your plan includes Fable.

showNote.title: Note beneath answers
showNote.description: A line under each answer naming the model and why, for surfaces with no status line.

layaUrl.title: laya-serve URL (optional)
layaUrl.description: A running laya-serve (e.g. http://localhost:8000) classifies unclear prompts on your machine for zero tokens, before the Haiku judge.

layaApiKey.title: laya-serve API key
layaApiKey.description: Sent as a Bearer token; leave empty when laya-serve runs without LAYA_API_KEY.

haikuEffort.title: Haiku effort
haikuEffort.description: Effort when the router moves you to Haiku (on your own model your /effort stays, so its cache stays too).

sonnetEffort.title: Sonnet effort
sonnetEffort.description: Effort when the router moves you to Sonnet (on your own model your /effort stays, so its cache stays too).

opusEffort.title: Opus effort
opusEffort.description: Effort when the router moves you to Opus (on your own model your /effort stays, so its cache stays too).

fableEffort.title: Fable effort
fableEffort.description: Effort when the router moves you to Fable (on your own model your /effort stays, so its cache stays too).
